text_block_list.text:
After her humiliating defeat in the
exhibition
race, Симболи Рудольф no
longer believes she
deserves to call
herself the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But despite her bitter tears, I gently
reassure her
that she was, and still is,
worthy. And, as if to
prove it...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She lifts her head to see a crowd of
Umamusume.
The students she devoted
herself to have turned
out in force to
support her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her fierce will blazes in her eyes once
more as she
remembers what it truly
means to be the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
